records.explanation: The warehouse has no exchange-rate table, and the notes don't say whether amount_open in intermediate.int_invoices or total_open in marts.receivables_aging is already in USD, so the answer could be either "average of USD-only balances" (filter currency = 'USD' on amount_open) or "average of all balances converted to USD" (not possible without a rate source); which do you want?

None of the listed tables (intermediate.int_customers, intermediate.int_invoices, marts.deal_to_cash, marts.receivables_aging, marts.revenue_by_customer, and the staging tables) has a credit score or any credit-rating column, so the warehouse cannot answer this.

None of the listed tables (staging.stg_deals, marts.deal_to_cash, staging.stg_orders, staging.stg_invoices, and the rest) has a salesperson or user column, and no users or salesperson table is listed, so the warehouse cannot say who closed each deal.

Gross margin needs cost of goods sold, and no table in the warehouse has a cost, unit cost, or COGS field: marts.deal_to_cash, marts.receivables_aging, marts.revenue_by_customer, and the staging and intermediate invoice, order, payment, and deal tables only carry revenue, invoiced, paid, and open amounts.

The warehouse notes list no support or helpdesk ticket table (only customers, invoices, deals, orders, payments, partners and the marts built from them), so ticket counts for Acme Corporation cannot be derived from it.
The warehouse records invoices already dated and issued, and none are dated November 2026, so it holds no forecast of next month's billing; the zero result only means no November invoices exist yet.
